audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys[4] and spikes[3].text both told the player Pop Blossom's channel "is long and telegraphed" / "telegraphs hard", with no qualification.
audit.why: Riot's own ability text ends with "The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised." The telegraph the advice depends on is exactly the thing that disappears in the situation where Neeko is most likely to ult — walking at you wearing an ally's model. A Teemo player trained to wait for a visible wind-up will hold Move Quick until after the knock-up lands.
audit.corrected: The wind-up only reads while she is undisguised; under Inherent Glamour there is nothing to see, so respect any ally-looking unit that walks into range.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.wants.foe[1] attributed the disguise to Neeko's W: "Use her W clone disguise".
audit.why: Two different abilities are being merged. Inherent Glamour (P) is the disguise that makes her look like an ally champion. Shapesplitter (W) sends out a clone. They create different problems — the passive makes you misidentify her, the clone makes you mistarget — and the counterplay differs, so collapsing them into "W clone disguise" leaves the player unable to read either.
audit.corrected: Inherent Glamour (P) is the ally disguise; Shapesplitter (W) is the clone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's Q was written as "Blinding Shot" in seven separate fields: whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], whys[3], spikes[1].text, wants.you[0], wants.foe[1] and early.
audit.why: Riot's name for Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. This was the densest concentration of the error in the slice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs was described only as having "a long cooldown at rank 1".
audit.why: It is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s. Naming the number turns a vague reassurance into a usable window: a dodged root is a full poke rotation, and the cooldown barely moves across ranks, so the window stays roughly the same size all lane.
audit.corrected: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 and only drops to 10s at rank 5 — one dodge buys the same window all game.

edits.after: Land Blinding Dart the instant Neeko walks up to trade so her auto burst does nothing and your poison does all the work

edits.before: At level 1 Neeko's Blooming Burst out-ranges your auto, so do not step up to poke at level 1 — farm with the tip of your auto and accept that she dictates spacing until you hit level 2. She will attempt to Q-poke and walk back into the brush to reset, so pre-place one mushroom at the tribush entrance before she reaches level 2 to burn a movement speed item or slow her retreat. The moment Blinding Shot comes online at level 2, the dynamic shifts: she cannot safely auto-trade into a blinded state, and her Tangle-Barbs (E) is the only threat left — dodge it by side-stepping toward the wall when she angles into brush.

edits.before: Pop Blossom's channel is long and telegraphed; a charged W Move Quick lets you sprint out of range, and your shroom net makes her approach paths dangerous.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's wind-up reads clearly only while she is undisguised — Inherent Glamour hides it, so treat any odd-looking ally unit as a live ultimate.

edits.before: Neeko's Pop Blossom is her strongest tool but telegraphs hard — shrooms on the approach paths mean she cannot walk through brush to set it up safely.
edits.after: Pop Blossom telegraphs hard — unless Inherent Glamour is up, which hides the wind-up; shroom her approach paths so a disguised Neeko still trips one first.

edits.before: Use her W clone disguise to create uncertainty about which target to track so you waste Blinding Shot on a clone
edits.after: Wear Inherent Glamour as an ally and split your attention with a Shapesplitter clone so Blinding Dart hits the wrong body

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1 — the root that starts everything. Dodge it and you own the next 12s. - Blooming Burst: 9s, 800 range. - Pop Blossom: its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised.
